mustFix.problem: The range line 'Vinyl re-side: $14,000 to $28,000' and its '(typical house, tear-off and wrap included)' note render as pale text on a near-white block/highlight: unreadable, far under 3:1, and it is the tool's answer.
mustFix.fix: Remove the light background/highlight on the output element (check ::selection or mark styling); set the range in ember #F28C4E mono on the dark panel at the size of the squares figure and the note in frost #E9EEF1; re-shoot motion and reduced-motion.

elevate.move: Create one scale-contrast moment in the course language: set the C-03 or C-07 heading as a full-width stack of tall-narrow display lines, each line exactly one --course tall, so the type is the siding; retire the repeated tracked-caps labels so mono only ever means a measurement.

Design the calculator and visualizer outputs as one 'wall readout' course board: range, squares and exposure each on a lap board with full-contrast ember numerals, announced through a single aria-live sentence, with a designed 3px frost-blue focus ring on every input across paper and dark tones.
